14.t: To change toggle positions on the switch assemblies, you need not remove the game PCB. The switches, usually colored blue, are easily accessibie when the game PCB is mounted in place.
When changing the options, verify proper results on the TV monitor display during self-test. A switch toggle in the on position Figure 7 Option Switch Settings

is indicated by a 1 for that switch on the TV monitor display. A switch in the off position is indicated by the number 0 (see example given at bottom of this figure). All switch settings are displayed on the monitor exactly as you view the corresponding switches on the game PCB, with toggles #1 on the right and toggles #4 and #8 on the left.
